+from copy import deepcopy

+def merge_settings(defaults: dict, overrides: dict) -> dict:
+    """
+    Recursively merge two dictionaries.
+
+    - Nested dictionaries are merged recursively
+    - Non-dict values (including None, lists, primitives) from overrides replace defaults
+    - Returns an independent deep copy so mutations to result don't affect inputs
+    - Neither input is modified during merging
+    """
+    result = deepcopy(defaults)
+
+    for key, override_value in overrides.items():
+        if (key in result and
+            isinstance(result[key], dict) and
+            isinstance(override_value, dict)):
+            # Recursively merge nested dictionaries
+            result[key] = merge_settings(result[key], override_value)
+        else:
+            # Override replaces default for non-dict values (including None and lists)
+            result[key] = override_value

     return result
